function.name: get_form
function.description: Retrieve a Google Forms form as a compact factual summary: title, quiz mode, question count and types, total points, a short question preview, plus a publish summary (is_published, is_accepting_responses, student_link_usable, responder_uri, edit_uri). Use it to inspect a form, resolve a form_id, or check whether a student link works before sending it. It does not dump every question by default.

form_id.description: Exact form ID returned by create_form or a previous tool result.

include_items.description: Set true only when the teacher explicitly asks to list the form's questions. Adds a compact list (title, type, points, option count) capped at 100 questions.
